svg.title: C06-M06-F2: SSRF and the server's network position
svg.desc: A diagram showing the server fetching attacker-chosen internal or metadata URLs, with the fix of a default-deny allowlist and blocked internal address ranges.
svg.text: C06-M06-F2 SSRF and the server's network position
app (inside network) fetches: internal service | 169.254.169.254 metadata
returns contents the attacker could not reach directly (SSRF)
fixed: default-deny allowlist + block private/loopback/link-local ranges
Figure C06-M06-F2. SSRF abuses the server's reach into internal and metadata endpoints;
default-deny allowlisting and range blocking prevent it [C06-M06-R3].
